meta.title: AQA GCSE English Language Mock Paper Bank
meta.subtitle: Original AQA-style GCSE English Language practice papers with secure OpenAI-assisted marking
notes: All sources, extracts and questions are original mock materials and are not official AQA papers.
Each generated paper contains four questions worth 4, 8, 20 and 40 marks and is designed for 1 hour 25 minutes.
The browser saves the selected paper pack and student responses locally on that device.

questions.instructionsTop: Write a description suggested by this picture, or write a story suggested by this title.
questions.questionText: Either write a description of a place that seems strange or half-hidden, or write a story about arriving somewhere before sunrise.
bulletPoints: Communicate clearly and imaginatively
Organise ideas and use a range of vocabulary and sentence forms
Use accurate spelling, punctuation and grammar

rubric.name: AO5/AO6 creative writing
rubric.notes: Award up to 24 marks for content and organisation and up to 16 marks for technical accuracy.
